The twelve are [List](/framework/core/List/), [Sidebar](/framework/core/Sidebar/), [Events](/framework/core/Events/), [Doc](/framework/ext/Doc/), [highlight](/framework/ext/highlight/), [grip](/framework/ext/grip/), [layout](/framework/ext/layout/), [Saver](/framework/ext/Saver/), [ui/tree](/framework/ui/tree/), [ux/Tree](/framework/ux/Tree/), [ui/field](/framework/ui/field/) a
